name: Sandworm vs Ukraine grid: Enterprise techniques 2016-2022
description: IT-side (Enterprise) techniques around the three Sandworm grid attacks. Official ATT&CK v20.1 mappings for C0034, S0693 (CaddyWiper), S1072 and S0604, plus techniques mapped by Stelios Partsinevelos from ESET's April 2022 report (marked 'ESET:' in comments). Score = number of the three attacks.
